headline: Revenue grows steadily as profitability softens sequentially
summary_short: Jack Henry & Associates reported FY2026 Q1 revenue of $636.2M, up 8.7% y/y and 2.7% q/q, while diluted EPS of $1.71 was roughly flat q/q (-$0.01) and up 12.5% y/y from $1.52.
summary_long: Revenue rose 8.7% y/y and 2.7% q/q to $636.2M. Gross margin was 42.8%, up ~100bp y/y but down ~50bp q/q. Operating income, EBIT, EBITDA, net income, and pretax income each fell 1.4%-3.4% sequentially while still up 9.2%-11.8% y/y. Diluted EPS of $1.71 was flat q/q (-$0.01) and up 12.5% y/y from $1.52. Total cash dropped 27.1% q/q and 48.4% y/y to $20.6M, while long-term debt rose to $90.0M from $20.0M q/q.
